en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing scenes from a lakeside campground. The top-left image features children using a metal slide near caravans and a small building. The top-right image shows children playing on a tall slide structure set in a lake, with a sailboat in the background; a sign is fixed to the platform. The bottom-left image shows children playing on a wooden toy train in a grassy area with caravans behind. The bottom-right image depicts two adults in swimwear sitting at a table outside a large tent or awning, eating or drinking. In the center, bold text reads the name of the campsite: "Campingplatz Stausee Radeburg."
